name: void-singularity-renderer
description: Standalone real-time WebGL renderer for the V.O.I.D desktop black-hole formation effect. Visual prototype only — no business logic.

notes.runtime: Pure browser + WebGL. No bundler, no backend, no build step required.
notes.three: The demo loads three@0.128.0 + its postprocessing addons from a CDN. Run `npm install` to vendor them into node_modules and repoint the <script> tags in index.html for offline use.
notes.excluded: No AI, voice, RiskGate, KillSwitch, filesystem, memory, device control, auth, telemetry, analytics, or networking of any kind.
